items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: I remember I did the obligato background to 'My Old Flame.' With Mae West in the picture.

ctx.x: The reason I'm asking specifically is because I think it would be very interesting to see an old film made during that era right now -- maybe on television -- and hear the trombone and realize that that is Lawrence Brown playing on that film score, which most people don't know. That's why I was wondering if you could remember any of the films --

Well, this was later on in the career when we played behind Mae West. I remember I did the obligato background to 'My Old Flame.' With Mae West in the picture. I think that's about the only time I ever did that. And then
I worked with other orchestras in pictures -- just gangs and gangs of them.
